# History rewrite of 2026-10-07: commit map

On 2026-10-07 the history of this repository was rewritten before the public launch. The rewrite removed words that the project's neutrality rule excludes, and one personal handle, from old commits, commit messages and paths.

- **Trees.** Every branch tip and every tag has a tree byte-identical to the one before the rewrite. Released archives, validation records and the current sources are unchanged.
- **Intermediate commits.** Commits whose files held one of those words have different trees. In those commits the words read `redacted`, and paths such as `examples/<word>/` became `examples/redacted/`.
- **Dates and authors.** Author and committer dates and authors are unchanged.
- **Old commit ids.** Commit ids cited in the docs before this date, for example in reviews, records and ADRs, are pre-rewrite ids. The table below maps each one to its new id.
- **Not covered.** Old ids of commits that existed only on pull-request heads are not in this map.
- **Audit record.** The owner keeps a private bundle of the pre-rewrite history.

Format: `old new`, one commit per line.
